capabilities: Draw a Bases graph with tags, folders and properties as hubs
Tag, retag and merge values by dragging nodes
Rename or remove a tag across the notes in the base
Hide rare values and split tags by folder
Show details for a value: usage, folders, co-occurring values and look-alikes
disambiguation: Not limited to tags: folders, formulas and any note property can also be the hubs.
extras: Makes no network requests and bundles d3-force; built for bases of up to a few thousand notes. A one-time GitHub star prompt appears after an update, never on a fresh install or at start-up.
intentEvidence: the controls you know from Obsidian's own graph view, with the same ranges and defaults
motivation: Started from six months of open graph and tag feature requests on the Obsidian forum, collected into a list of what the plugin should answer.
problem: Notes that share tags or properties but never link to each other have no visible relationship, and retagging or merging tags means editing notes one at a time.
summary: Bases graph view where tags, folders and properties are hubs, with drag-and-drop tagging, merging, renaming and a tag sidebar.
